messages.author: 53004ae9e1969cac
messages.subject: Problems with readTranscriptFeatures function
parts:
Hello all,

I have been workind with methylkit recently but I found one problem with one function of the package genomation related with methylkit. My code is the following:

gene_meth <- readTranscriptFeatures(location = 'genes_v5.bed')

and that returns me the following error:

Reading the table...
Calculating intron coordinates...
Error in .Call2("solve_user_SEW0", start, end, width, PACKAGE = "IRanges") :
  solving row 3671: negative widths are not allowed

I supposed that was some mistake of the strand/end column but I checked that all the columns respect that start < end, so this is not the problem.

The genes_v5.bed file have the following form when I load it with R:


and the row that is giving me the error is:


I can not understand why is giving me this problem if clearly the start column is smaller than the end column. In addition I also remove the information of isoforms in order to avoid name problems.

I would be very thankfull if someone can give me some hint about how to fix this problem with the function readTranscriptFeatures().

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Problems with readTranscriptFeatures function
parts:
The error implies there is sth wrong with Exon/intron coordinate calculation. Is the bed file from UCSC ? Or somehow converted from another format?

 Best
Altuna
